response.overview: Lucky (Anna Marie Myšičková) looks for answers in fortune cookies. But even more important to her is the opinion of her older sister, Viki (Alžběta Malá). But while for one, the words hidden in the cookie are proof of their sisterly bond, for the other, they’re just a scrap of paper. Will they manage, during an afternoon spent together, to overcome their estrangement—even if only for a moment—or has the time come to answer the uncomfortable question: What if they weren’t sisters?
response.title: Kdybychom nebyly sestry
